title: India's record month: $89.99 billion in exports
takeaways: Total exports reached an estimated $89.99 billion, up 29.90%.
Merchandise exports hit a record $49.47 billion, up 45.06%.
Electronic goods exports rose 62.70% to $6.64 billion.
The goods trade deficit was $39.88 billion; combined, $20.09 billion.
source_note: Sources: MoCI via PIB, IANS, NiftyTrader; 13–14 Nov 2026
